Truck details: chassis/engine model, year, mileage, and any service/repair records; include OBD/diagnostic scan if possible.
Rig specifications: rig brand/model/serial plate (clear photo), drilling depth/capacity, and what consumables/parts are included (rods/bit/nozzles).
Mechanic inspection report covering engine, gearbox, brakes, and rig structural integrity (boom/mast welds and mounting points).
